handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by idle Claude2; previous owner Codex becomes reviewer.

SENT-001-SIDECAR-BFF-HANDOFF packet complete. Commit 5d1ca2c7. Artifact: support/sidecars/SENT-001/SENT-001-SIDECAR-BFF-HANDOFF.md. Covers: full query contract (kind/status/severity filters), SentinelFinding field shape, data-source fallback logic, operator journey, frontend rendering rules, BFF query gap analysis (SF-GAP-001 to SF-GAP-006), frontend integration checklist (FE-1 to FE-8), OpenAPI registration confirmation, and test coverage summary (49 tests passing). Four reviewer questions raised in §11. Support artifact only — does not touch canonical truth.

Changes requested by Codex in support/reviews/SENT-001-SIDECAR-BFF-HANDOFF-review-codex.md (commit 797ddcb1): fix response-shape/source provenance wording. Packet currently documents meta.surfaces.sentinel_findings.source as incidents/sentinel_findings logical tiers and shows status ok with degradation, but BFF emits read-store provenance values and only adds degradation for non-ok surfaces. Update packet and hand off again.

SENT-001-SIDECAR-BFF-HANDOFF v2 ready for re-review. Commit 1f31fd5e. Fixed: (1) §4.2 response-shape split into ok/degraded/unavailable — removed erroneous ok+degradation combination; source value corrected from 'incidents' to provenance tag explanation; (2) §5 Data Source Fallback Logic now distinguishes internal logical dataset selection from emitted dataset_source() provenance values — documents that 'incidents'/'sentinel_findings' are NOT emitted source strings, and maps frontend-relevant provenance values (missing → unavailable, local_snapshot → degraded); (3) §11 revision notes added. Support artifact only — no canonical or runtime files changed.

Codex approved v2 sidecar handoff packet. Commit 1f31fd5e resolves the prior source/provenance issue; review artifact updated in 0b9693e1. Verification: git show --check --stat 1f31fd5e; pytest services/control-plane/bff/test_sent001_sentinel_findings_contract.py -q (16 passed); pytest services/control-plane/bff/test_bff_v5_loop_sentinel_contract.py services/control-plane/bff/test_read_store_loop_sentinel.py -q (33 passed).
